items.source: Creates new AggregationExpression that calculates the mathematical derivative value.
items.translation: 创建一个新的AggregationExpression，用于计算数学导数值。

items.source: Create a new instance of ArithmeticOperators.Derivative for the value stored at the given field holding a numeric value.
items.translation: 为给定字段中存储的数值创建一个 ArithmeticOperators.Derivative 的新实例。

items.source: Create a new instance of ArithmeticOperators.Derivative for the value provided by the given expression that resolves to a numeric value.
items.translation: 为给定表达式提供的数值创建一个新的 ArithmeticOperators.Derivative 实例，该表达式解析结果为数值。

items.source: Support for the MongoDB aggregation framework.
items.translation: 支持 MongoDB 聚合框架。
ArithmeticOperators.Derivative 在 org.springframework.data.mongodb.core.aggregation 中的用途
